profile.headline:
SAP ABAP Consultant 
S/4Hana Developer
profile.summary:
SAP ABAP Sr Consultant with 14+ years of experience, Certified in “ABAP with SAP NetWeaver 7.50” and "ABAP for SAP S/4 HANA". Developing solutions primarily for MM, PP, SD, FI, TRM in projects of Roll Outs, Implementations, Upgrades and Leading teams of ABAP Consultants as an ABAP Architect, primarily in different versions of SAP ECC 6.0 and S/4 Hana.

Certifications.
-SAP Certified Development Associate ABAP with SAP NetWeaver 7.50.
-SAP Certified Development Associate - Programming in SAP S/4HANA for SAP Net Weaver ABAP Programmers
-SAP Certified Development Associate ABAP with SAP NetWeaver 7.0.
-SAFe for teams
-SCRUM

positions.title: SAP Sr Software Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: AWS Step Functions · Amazon S3 · AWS Lambda · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SAP BTP · Cloud Computing

positions.title: ABAP S/4 HANA Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed OData Services for Master-Detail Fiori Applications regarding Purchase Requisitions.
•	Brownfield approach to move from ECC to S/4 HANA.
•	S/4HANA Conversion of Custom Code (S4HANA_READINESS) and Performance Analysis
(PERFORMANCE_DB) with ATC and SCI tool.
•	Created CDS Views and AMDP for poor performance programs increasing performance up
to 500%.
•	Activated My Inbox standard Fiori App for users and did support to Fiori Like applications.
•	Usage of Enhancement Framework (Implicit and Explicit Enhancements) to enhance Sales Order
creations.

positions.title: ABAP architect and ABAP S/4 HANA
positions.description:
•	In charge of TRM-ARCE Module, supporting client specifications and project analysis, 
application designs and development activities. 
•	In charge of creating technical and functional specifications for ABAP team, code review and
Production system support.
•	In charge of small ABAP teams and Infonavit internal projects.
•	OData developer for Work List and Master-Detail UI5 Fiori applications. Created Fiori Catalogs
and Groups in Fiori Launchpad Designer for user´s roles.
•	Created Information Models (HANA Views) in HANA Studio and View Proxies for its 
consumption in ABAP Application Layer.
•	Developed Web Services and Proxies Consumers for information transfer through ECC 
system and external systems.

positions.title: ABAP Sr Consultant.
positions.description:
•	Upgrade from ECC 4.6 to ECC 6.0.
•	Supervising ABAP team of 6 senior ABAP consultants.
•	ABAP developer for MM, SD and FI modules. Attending meetings with client and functional 
team.
•	I created many Exits like User Exits, Customer Exits, BADIs for requirements of enhancing 
standard functionality of Purchase Orders, Sales Orders, Deliveries and Purchase Requisitions 
transactions.
•	In charge of improving performance of custom code based on Best Practices.

positions.title: ABAP Analyst Consultant.
positions.description:
•	In change of giving ABAP support to many different clients of Capgemini. 
•	I was assigned to the IT internal team of the client for one month to be their SAP ABAP trainer 
but I ended up for about one and a half years like the only ABAP in the company, helping them 
to attend all of their needs.

positions.title: ABAP Consultant
positions.description:
•	SAP-ABAP Developer in the module of FM (Budgeting), developing Dialog Applications related to 
creation, modification, and deletion of Areas, Funds, URs (Responsible Units), CT (Work Centers).
•	Gave support to IDOC ALE interfaces for Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders.
•	Created RFC interfaces with Java Connectors (JCOs) to communicate with ISSSTE Portal.
•	In charge of massive loadings of BPs creation through BAPIs, Proxy management with PI team.

positions.title: ABAP Consultant
positions.description:
•	In charge of RICEF objects construction as ABAP Developer, I created many reports, ALVs, Module Pools, Call Transaction, Smart Forms, Function Modules, BAPIS, BADIs, Batch Input, Data dictionary elements and the development of User Exits por Sales & Distribution (SD) and Material Management (MM).
•	I was one of the 5 developers chosen (out of the 30) to be part of Accenture Internal Team after 3 months of being tested.
•	At Accenture I took the ABAP Academy of 160 hours.
